rules.statement: A person claiming to be the owner of a piece of land which had been partitioned by others in a proceeding under Ordinance No. 11 of 1863 cannot claim damages under section 9 of the Ordinance from the parties to the partition action if they acted bona fide and in ignorance of the rights of the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: If any owner or co-owner is aware of the pendency of the partition action and abstains from coming forward he cannot afterwards claim damages.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Provided that nothing herein contained shall affect the right of any party prejudiced by such partition or sale to recover damages from the parties by whose act, whether of commission or omission, such damage had accrued.
